messages:
Tara Singh: Proposal: introduce a 7-day "ownership lease" for P1 followups, 14-day for P2, with automatic 48h reminders. TTL forces short handoffs and fewer stale cards.

Omar Haddad: Sounds good. How do we handle handoffs?

Tara Singh: Minimal YAML snippet to include in the epic when ownership changes (from/to/date/summary/blockers/success_metric). Must be added to the issue body.

Riley Park: Also require a one-line success metric on each followup, e.g., error_rate < 0.1% or repro=false. That makes closure objective.

followup-bot: Followup created -> FUP-9122 (owner: Tara Singh). TTL: 7d. Reminder scheduled in 48h.

Omar Haddad: For comms cadence during active followups: weekly status in the epic; interim quick updates if TTL is active. Keep each update 2-3 bullets: what changed / next step / ETA.

Tara Singh: For recurrence detection: run a 30-day similarity scan (stack fingerprints + metric patterns). If score>0.8, auto-create a candidate followup and attach reason.

Riley Park: Small ops ask: when bot creates followups, pin the epic link in the original incident thread and add a single-line checklist. UX helps adoption.

Tara Singh: Action items: add YAML handoff to runbook (Tara) - PR in 48h; wire followup-bot TTL + escalation (Omar) - prototype in 5 days; enable recurrence candidate job (Riley) - spike in 10 days. Trial on next two P1s.

Omar Haddad: I'll start the bot work.

Riley Park: +1 to trial.

Tara Singh: thanks all, posting runbook PR soon. :rocket:
